title: The Crimson Cipher
description: A wealthy art collector was found murdered, and a cryptic cipher was left at the scene. Connect the clues to find the killer.

clue-1.title: Police Report
clue-1.content: Victim: Lord Harrington. Found dead in his study at 11:00 PM. A window was broken from the inside. A red cipher was written on the wall in blood: 'THE RAVEN FLIES AT MIDNIGHT'.

clue-2.title: Suspect: Arthur Penhaligon
clue-2.content: Harrington's nephew. Claims he was at the theater until midnight. Needs verification.

clue-3.title: Theater Ticket
clue-3.content: A torn theater ticket for 'The Raven', stamped at 10:30 PM. Found in Arthur's coat.

clue-4.title: The Nephew's Lie
clue-4.content: Arthur claims he was at the theater until midnight, but 'The Raven' is the cipher. The ticket proves he was there, but it connects him to the message.

combinations.message: You decided to search Arthur's coat after reading the police report.
Aha! 'The Raven' is the play Arthur attended. He must be connected to the cipher!
